tileEnv.SH_FIXTURE_DESC: Acorn BBC Micro Model B (1981) at its own untouched power-on screen: "BBC Computer 32K / Acorn DFS / BASIC / >" in white MODE 7 teletext on black, drawn fullscreen with aspect correction by a purpose-built MAME 0.289 `bbcb` on the bridge base's stock 1024x768 X root. Nothing is curated and nothing is typed. The machine is MAME's own default configuration — MOS 1.20, BBC BASIC II, and the Acorn 8271 disc interface with DNFS 1.20, which is what prints the "Acorn DFS" line. -artwork_crop removes the driver's LED strip so the exhibit is the picture and nothing else. CAPS LOCK is on at reset (the MOS switches it on), so unshifted letters arrive upper case, which is what BASIC's tokeniser needs; thirteen characters sit on different keys from a US PC and are translated by SH_KEY_MAP. Keyboard-only exhibit; no pointer device; SN76489 sound -> ALSA -> AC97.

reset.fixture: Acorn BBC Micro Model B power-on screen (BBC Computer 32K / Acorn DFS / BASIC / >) in MAME 0.289 `bbcb`, fullscreen with -keepaspect -artwork_crop on the bridge base's stock 1024x768 X root; golden INTERNAL snapshot restores the untouched cold boot. Nothing is curated and no post-restore keys are sent. Keyboard route certified 2026-08-09 AFTER the bake, against the restored fixture: the registry demoProgram's five lines typed at the tile's shipped 80/80 pacing and RUN paint a MODE 1 fan of coloured lines, asserted by lit-pixel count — a listing corrupted by an unmapped '=' or bracket leaves the screen a teletext banner full of 'Mistake' and fails. Keyboard-only exhibit (no mouse); AC97 audio.

notes: Preservation-source ROMs with NO authorised fetch URL: the operator stages five blobs at /data/assets-staging/bbcmicro/ and the builder gates each on SHA-1. Never commit the bits.
The `saa5050` teletext character generator is a THIRD MAME zip, in no BIOS set; without it MODE 7 has no glyphs and MAME refuses to start.
